statements.status_notes: Vaultwarden ships only the MariaDB Connector/C client library from Debian's libmariadb3 package; it does not ship MariaDB Server, server plugins, mariadb-dump, or a database data directory. This advisory affects MariaDB Server functionality, not Connector/C. The separate Connector/C advisory from this release is CVE-2026-107819. See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-85745
